achievements.name: All Achievements Unlocked
achievements.description: Zach, it's over, all finished. It's time for you to leave town.  Are you ready to go?

achievements.name: Prologue CLEARED
achievements.description: FBI Special Agent  Francis York Morgan. Please, just call me York.

achievements.name: Episode 1 CLEARED
achievements.description: George, the perpetrator is just like  you. He's passionate about women. He's a passionate kisser. This was a "kiss of death".

achievements.name: Episode 2 (part 1) CLEARED
achievements.description: So Becky is Miss Stiletto Heel. And she gave the locket to the twins... Must be the "special secret" Lilly told  us about, Zach.

achievements.name: Episode 2 (part 2) CLEARED
achievements.description: Zach, Diane has become the third  victim of our killer. And nada from questioning Nick... Nothing. Got no new leads from questioning Nick.

achievements.name: Episode 3 CLEARED
achievements.description: Zach, OK. So it's not bonus footage, it's still part of the main feature. The perpetrator is exactly who  I thought it was.

achievements.name: Episode 4 CLEARED
achievements.description: Ah, right, he doesn't have a "tattoo"  on his back. But there is a "pattern" there.

achievements.name: Episode 5 CLEARED
achievements.description: Zach, I need you to pray with me. Pray that things have not gone too far. All we can do is go to the location written in Kaysen's letter.

achievements.name: Episode 6 CLEARED
achievements.description: My name is York. Me and you,  we'll always be together. OK, Zach? I'm you, and you are me. Now, give me your hand.

achievements.name: Episode 7 CLEARED
achievements.description: Then this is goodbye, Zach. Thank you for everything.

achievements.name: Delivery Man Q
achievements.description: Show Becky the Diary found in Anna's room and tell her that "Delivery Man Q is in trouble". Then sneak into Quint's  trailer to find proof that he is acting  as a delivery man.

achievements.name: Guardian of the Art Gallery
achievements.description: Find the [The Girl in the Woods] painting hidden in the gallery and deliver it to Diane.

achievements.name: Memories of Anna
achievements.description: Find Carol in Anna's Woods and give her the [Out of Focus Picture] received from Isaach and Isaiah.

achievements.name: Lost Arnold
achievements.description: George lost his favorite dumbbell named [Arnold].  Find it and give it to him.

achievements.name: Nameless Flower
achievements.description: George wants to give his sick mother flowers; a special flower that only blossoms when it rains.  Find this [Flower with No Name] and give it to him.

achievements.name: Nice Try Cooking
achievements.description: Emily needs some "Fermented Dairy  Products" for her cooking. Find some and give it to her.

achievements.name: Another Nice Try Cooking
achievements.description: Emily needs some "Vegetables that become sweet when fried" for her cooking. Find some and give them to her.

achievements.name: Memorable Cooking
achievements.description: Emily needs: "Salty and Crunchy items" "2 colored and soft items" "Yellow Sauce" for her cooking.  Find these items and give them to her.

achievements.name: Unwanted Customer
achievements.description: Jack, who usually shows up after 9, gives Carol a hard time and this troubles Thomas. Make Jack go home when he shows up at the bar.

achievements.name: Periodic Riddle
achievements.description: Ushah has no idea what the answer is to Fiona's riddle. Figure it out and tell Ushah what the answer is.

achievements.name: Snack for Willie
achievements.description: Willie took some bones that were supposed to be delivered to Brian. Go get them back from Willie.

achievements.name: Someone in the Forest
achievements.description: From time to time, someone is entering the woods.  That person may be the murderer.  Hide behind Anna's Tree to find out, then go tell the twins who it is.

achievements.name: Legendary Tabatha
achievements.description: Borrow the [Rod of Legends] from Jim and catch the legendary fish named Tabitha.

achievements.name: Map to Psychic Spot A
achievements.description: Go to the psychic point on the map you bought at the Milk Barn.

achievements.name: Map to Psychic Spot B
achievements.description: Go to the psychic point on the map  you bought at the Milk Barn

achievements.name: Map to Psychic Spot C
achievements.description: Go to the psychic point on the map  you bought at the Milk Barn.

achievements.name: The Bond Between Men
achievements.description: Give the Legendary Guitar you received from Lilly back to Keith.

achievements.name: Part Time Job 1
achievements.description: You are asked to clean the Milk Barn Storage Room by pushing the boxes around.

achievements.name: Part Time Job 2
achievements.description: You are asked to clean the Milk Barn Storage Room by pushing the boxes around.

achievements.name: Part Time Job 3
achievements.description: You are asked to clean the Milk Barn Storage Room by pushing the boxes around.

achievements.name: The Legendary Guitar
achievements.description: Use the key to the closet to open the closet in Keith's Garage.

achievements.name: Greenvale Trivia
achievements.description: Harry will ask you mulitple choice questions regarding Greenvale. Answer three in a row correctly.

achievements.name: Incomplete Treasure
achievements.description: Michael lost a very important item that he received from Harry.  Find it and hand it back to him.

achievements.name: Nick's Letter
achievements.description: Nick asked you to deliver a letter he wrote while in jail. Deliver [Letter from Nick] to Olivia.

achievements.name: Big Bag
achievements.description: Use the key to the back door of the Diner to get into the kitchen and search the place.

achievements.name: A Return to Better Things
achievements.description: Olivia asked you to deliver a letter about her true feelings. Deliver [Letter from Olivia] to Nick.

achievements.name: Where's the Dress?
achievements.description: Anna's mother Sallie is looking for [Anna's Dress]. Find it and give it to her.

achievements.name: Anna's Dairy
achievements.description: Use [Anna's Key] to go into her room and find [Anna's Diary].

achievements.name: Engagement Ring
achievements.description: Quint knows something but isn't  talking. Get him to talk by handing him Becky's [Engagement Ring].

achievements.name: Top Rank
achievements.description: Break Richard's record in a game of Count Up.

achievements.name: Pure and Beautiful
achievements.description: Find the old picture of Polly and hand it to her.

achievements.name: Medical Studies
achievements.description: Fiona will ask you multiple choice  questions regarding medicine. Answer three in a row correctly.

achievements.name: Special Service
achievements.description: Get your car washed repeatedly until Gina offers some special service, then accept it.

achievements.name: Benjamin Franklin
achievements.description: Give Jack a [$100 Bribe]. He'll give some valuable info when the total  reaches over $1000.

achievements.name: Beginner Collector
achievements.description: Wesley is a trading card collector. He's asked you to find some cards.  Find eight cards and show them to Wesley.

achievements.name: Amateur Collector
achievements.description: Find 16 hidden trading cards in  Greenvale.

achievements.name: Normal Collector
achievements.description: Find 32 hidden trading cards in Greenvale.

achievements.name: Great Collector
achievements.description: Find 48 hidden trading cards in Greenvale.

achievements.name: Top Collector
achievements.description: Find 64 hidden trading cards in Greenvale.

achievements.name: Low Gear Parts
achievements.description: Find the [Low Gear Parts] in the Junk Yard. The General will use them to increase the performance of your car.

achievements.name: High Gear Parts
achievements.description: Find the [High Gear Parts] in the Junk Yard. The General will use them to increase the performance of your car.

achievements.name: Gas Tank Parts
achievements.description: Find the [Gas Tank Parts] in the Junk Yard. The General will use them to increase the performance of your car.

achievements.name: York's Car
achievements.description: According to Jack, the General has your old car in his junkyard. Ask him to fix it up for you.
